messages:
Leah: Quick thread 10m10m: need a concrete proposal for slotting thresholds + deprecation windows for the catalog. Customers are asking for clearer timelines and migration credits. Ideas?
Tom: +1. Current chaos: some models get soft-deprecated with 48h notice and customers freak out. We need standard bands (fast/normal/extended) and objective criteria.
Ivy: Proposal sketch: three sunset bands: Fast=7d, Normal=30d, Extended=90d. Assign band by impact_score and contract_status. Impact_score considers usage %, embed schema changes, and pinned status.
Pras: How do we measure usage%? active calls in last 30d / customer's total calls? That favors noisy small tenants. Maybe weight by revenue or SLA tier.
Leah: Use a hybrid: tenant_share = calls_last_30d weighted by account_tier_score. We'll keep a clear mapping: Tier S=1.0, M=0.6, L=0.3. We'll compute impact_score = tenant_share * tier_weight summed across customers.
Tom: Bench gating: require a rolling eval on 10k samples + regression delta < 2% for primary metrics OR explicit customer opt-in. If major architecture change (tokenizer/IO) -> require compat shim or 1:1 migration test.
Ivy: Opt-in path is important. Also: pin TTL rules. Customers can request pins for GA models; default pin TTL = 180 days with automated renewal prompts at 30/14/7 days. Emergency pin extension must go through CS + legal.
Pras: For migration credits, recommend 25% credit of monthly usage for customers who migrate within the window and adopt recommended shim. Bigger credits for enterprise with contractual clauses.
ops-bot: Note: last deprecation (1799001111) used ad-hoc credit of 10% and manual outreach.
Leah: Launch gates for onboarding new models: 1) bench suite pass >= 95 on weighted metrics, 2) infra hw_fit check OK (quantization tested), 3) telemetry integration (p95/err/throughput) added to Console, 4) at least 3 sandbox customers exercised.
Tom: Sandbox customers are scarce. Can we run a 'shadow traffic' week where 5% of production traffic mirrored to model for 7 days? Need SRE approval.
Ivy: Shadow is good but expensive. Alternative: synthetic workload + 3 curated enterprise queries per customer for QA.
Pras: Migration friction score: we should track historical migrations per model family. If family_migrations_fail_rate > 15% add a hard block unless product review signs off.
Leah: Agree. Add lineage flag: families with ABI or schema changes flagged require canary cohort testing (5 customers) before broad availability.
Tom: Deprecation comms: standard template with timeline, migration path, recommended model variants, and a checkbox for requesting pin/credit. Send to customer contacts at 30/14/7 days pre-deprecate.
Ivy: Add a 'no-surprise' rule: never deprecate a model that is pinned or referenced by active contracts. Also: publish a monthly 'catalog health' doc listing upcoming sunsets and new onboards.
Pras: Implementation workstream: a) policy DSL for bands and thresholds, b) Console UI for pin/renewal lifecycle, c) automation for credit issuance and audit trail. Estimate 3 sprints for MVP.
Leah: Owners: Leah=policy doc + comms templates, Tom=SRE for shadow traffic gating + infra checks, Ivy=bench/eval thresholds and sample spec, Pras=billing/credit flow and legal hooks.
ops-bot: Reminder: policy review meeting scheduled 1801300000 (calendar invite sent).
Leah: Action items: Ivy produce bench sample spec (EOD Thu), Pras prototype credit flow (next Tue), Tom write shadow-traffic runbook (end of sprint), Leah draft public catalog-health page (next Wed). If no objections I'll convert this thread into RFC. :wave:
